# APEX

> AI market briefs for any stock or coin (e.g. NVDA, BTC) that AI agents can buy per call: $0.50 in USDC on Base via the x402 payment standard. No account or API key. Wallets holding 10,000+ $APEX on Base get free access.

API base: https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app

## Endpoints

- [GET /brief?symbol=SYMBOL](https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app/brief?symbol=BTC): Paid brief, $0.50 USDC on Base. Returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment details until paid.
- [GET /brief/any?symbol=SYMBOL](https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app/brief/any?symbol=BTC): Free for verified $APEX holders, otherwise redirects to the paid route.
- [GET /brief/holder?symbol=SYMBOL](https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app/brief/holder?symbol=BTC): Free for wallets holding 10,000+ $APEX. Headers: X-Wallet-Address, X-Wallet-Message (URL-encoded "APEX access\nWallet: <address>\nTime: <ms>"), X-Wallet-Signature. Signatures valid 5 minutes.
- [GET /demo?symbol=SYMBOL](https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app/demo?symbol=BTC): Free, rate-limited demo.
- [GET /openapi.json](https://web-production-8a4a.up.railway.app/openapi.json): OpenAPI spec.

## Response

JSON: {"symbol", "access", "brief"}. The brief has SNAPSHOT, NUMBERS, RISK CHECK, BOTTOM LINE, and a CALL object with asset, lens, direction, confidence, horizon_days. Calls are scored against outcomes over time.

## Docs

- [APEX for AI Agents](https://apex-web-omega.vercel.app/agents.html): Human-readable guide.
